Done! I fixed the session expiration bug in `/tmp/wk-rootcause-VsUnE7/repo/src/auth/session.js`. 

**The issue:** The condition used `now > expiresAt`, which allowed sessions to remain valid when `now` exactly equals `expiresAt`.

**The fix:** Changed it to `now >= expiresAt` so the session is immediately invalid once the expiration time is reached.

This fix ensures that:
- The auth middleware correctly rejects expired sessions at the exact expiration moment
- The cleanup job removes sessions at their expiration time
- Token refresh requests are rejected at expiration
